localCoordinates: x=(lon-113.56)*111.32*cos(22.16deg), z=(22.16-lat)*111.32; units km; this is not WGS84 GeoJSON.
source: OpenStreetMap via OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles; AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium)
underlyingDemResolution: Varies by upstream source; tile spacing is not a survey accuracy claim.
shoreWater: Distance-based visual treatment, not surveyed bathymetry.
texture: OSM cartographic land cover, roads and mapped building footprints; not satellite imagery.
elevationSmoothing: Gaussian sigma 0.45 raster pixel before bilinear sampling; negative elevations clamped on modern land.
peninsulaBuildings: Modern OSM building footprints via OpenFreeMap z14. Buildings use a 1:1 vertical scale while terrain remains exaggerated 2.6 times for legibility. Render height is used where supplied; untagged heights may be nominal. This is a present-day building massing visualisation, not a historic reconstruction or surveyed height model.
catPhotoMarker: Approximate position near Rua de Cinco de Outubro from user-supplied screenshots; photos supplied by the user. Individual shop and photo coordinates are unverified.
